column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 05 (M24005): Sangvis Ferri datang sebagai bala bantuan dan
# melumpuhkan Jupiter Cannon; Anjelie membatalkan tembakan karena tujuannya sudah tercapai.
# Tetap Inggris: Sangvis Ferri, Agent, Dreamer, Griffin, Dinergates, Jupiter Cannon,
# Nemesis, OTs-14, Krolik, Sextans, Helen, Boojum, The Elmo, Anjelie, Leaf-Cutter Army,
# Great Red Spot, Ceres, Mangi Security, Mokosh, Red Zone, Yellow Zone, Commander,
# Master, Doll, railgun, Messiah, Savior.
(Despite their best efforts, the Dolls, who are at an absolute numerical disadvantage, are still unable to break through the Leaf-Cutter Army's defense line.)
column2: (Meski sudah berusaha sekuat tenaga, para Doll yang kalah jumlah secara mutlak tetap tidak bisa menembus garis pertahanan Leaf-Cutter Army.)

column1: (The dense network of fire firmly suppresses the assault squad behind cover.)
column2: (Jaring tembakan yang rapat menekan regu serbu itu tetap di balik penutup.)

column1: (Although OTs-14 can make a breakthrough for a short time, with the opponent's continuous reinforcements, it is very difficult for the Dolls to break through to the third energy tower again.)
column2: (Meski OTs-14 bisa menerobos untuk waktu singkat, dengan bala bantuan musuh yang datang terus, sangat sulit bagi para Doll menembus sampai ke menara energi ketiga.)

column1: Tsk—too tough! How is their deployment reaction speed so fast! They're going to surround us!
column2: Cih—terlalu tangguh! Kenapa kecepatan reaksi pengerahan mereka secepat itu! Mereka akan mengepung kita!

column1: Not only is their individual combat proficiency high, but their tactical coordination is also flawless.
column2: Bukan cuma kemahiran tempur perorangannya tinggi, koordinasi taktis mereka juga tanpa cela.

column1: They've called up more defense modules to stop me from entering the system. I have to make physical contact with the circuit.
column2: Mereka memanggil lebih banyak modul pertahanan untuk mencegahku masuk ke sistem. Aku harus menyentuh sirkuitnya secara fisik.

column1: ...No, the Elmo is still waiting for us. We absolutely cannot give up now...
column2: ...Tidak, Elmo masih menunggu kita. Kita sama sekali tidak boleh menyerah sekarang...

column1: (OTs-14 picked up Helen with Boojum's arms and looked at the other two Dolls.)
column2: (OTs-14 mengangkat Helen dengan lengan Boojum-nya dan menoleh ke dua Doll lainnya.)

column1: Helen, keep trying to hack in. I'll carry you and charge through.
column2: Helen, terus coba tembus sistemnya. Aku akan menggendongmu dan menerobos.

column1: Understood, Captain.
column2: Dimengerti, Captain.

column1: Sextans and I will help block the bullets for you.
column2: Aku dan Sextans akan membantu menahan tembakan untuk kalian.

column1: Although we can't block too many. It's a pity we don't have enough people here.
column2: Meski tidak bisa menahan terlalu banyak. Sayang orang kita di sini tidak cukup.

column1: (The Dolls leap out of cover. Just as Krolik said, they provide full cover for OTs-14, forcing a breakthrough.)
column2: (Para Doll melompat keluar dari tempat berlindung. Seperti kata Krolik, mereka melindungi OTs-14 sepenuhnya, memaksa terjadi terobosan.)

column1: (But even with Krolik and Sextans' quick reactions, they eventually become riddled with wounds under the hail of bullets. They barely manage to escort Helen to the energy tower.)
column2: (Tapi meski reaksi Krolik dan Sextans cepat, akhirnya keduanya penuh luka di bawah hujan proyektil. Mereka nyaris tidak sanggup mengantar Helen sampai ke menara energi.)

column1: (Facing the continuous suppression from the military's armored forces, the squad quickly falls into a perilous situation where they are overwhelmed, and can only rely on OTs-14's power to cover Helen.)
column2: (Menghadapi tekanan tanpa henti dari pasukan lapis baja militer, regu itu cepat jatuh ke situasi berbahaya karena kewalahan, dan hanya bisa mengandalkan kekuatan OTs-14 untuk melindungi Helen.)

column1: (At the end of their line of sight, the railgun's main gun has begun to flash with a blinding white light—this means the launch has charged to the critical point!)
column2: (Di ujung garis pandang mereka, meriam utama railgun itu mulai berkelip cahaya putih yang menyilaukan—artinya pengisian dayanya sudah sampai titik kritis!)

column1: Helen! Are you done yet! The main gun is about to fire!
column2: Helen! Sudah selesai belum! Meriam utamanya hampir menembak!

column1: Almost there... The military's control system has a very high encryption level, and this time it's even more...
column2: Hampir... Sistem kontrol militer tingkat enkripsinya sangat tinggi, dan kali ini bahkan lebih...

column1: Wait—
column2: Tunggu—

column1: What's going on?
column2: Ada apa?

column1: In this system... something else is forcibly cutting in!
column2: Di dalam sistem ini... ada pihak lain yang memaksa masuk!

column1: Is it backup from the Commander!?
column2: Apa itu bantuan dari Commander!?

column1: No! The other party's protocol is completely different, and their methods are extremely brutal...
column2: Bukan! Protokol pihak itu sepenuhnya berbeda, dan caranya sangat brutal...

column1: It's even more familiar with this military system than I am!—Its hacking speed is faster than mine...!
column2: Dia bahkan lebih akrab dengan sistem militer ini daripada aku!—Kecepatan tembusnya lebih cepat dariku...!

column1: What?!
column2: Apa?!

column1: (Helen's pupils shrank sharply.)
column2: (Pupil Helen mengecil tajam.)

column1: Not good... Everyone attention! Find cover immediately to brace for impact! Hurry!
column2: Gawat... Semuanya perhatian! Segera cari perlindungan untuk menahan benturan! Cepat!

column1: ('Whoosh—Whoosh—')
column2: ('Wush—Wush—')

column1: (Before Helen's voice fell, a piercing shriek of something tearing through the air suddenly came from the sky.)
column2: (Sebelum suara Helen selesai, lengkingan menusuk sesuatu yang mencabik udara tiba-tiba datang dari langit.)

column1: ("Boom—Boom boom!!!")
column2: ("Duar—Duar duar!!!")

column1: (Several heavy rockets carrying special armor-piercing high-explosive warheads whistle out from behind the sand dunes on the base's flank in a tricky parabola, hitting the base of the enemy energy tower with extreme precision.)
column2: (Beberapa roket berat bermuatan hulu ledak penembus baja berdaya ledak tinggi meluncur berdesing dari balik gundukan pasir di sisi pangkalan dengan parabola yang licik, menghantam dasar menara energi musuh dengan presisi luar biasa.)

column1: It's going to explode—
column2: Akan meledak—

column1: (The energy tower collapsed rapidly, but it didn't cause any secondary explosions. Instead, it extinguished and fell to the ground.)
column2: (Menara energi itu runtuh cepat, tapi tidak menimbulkan ledakan sekunder. Sebaliknya, ia mati lalu jatuh ke tanah.)

column1: (Krolik lifted her head from the sand.)
column2: (Krolik mengangkat kepalanya dari pasir.)

column1: Could it be... our reinforcements?
column2: Jangan-jangan... bala bantuan kita?

column1: The received signal cannot be identified... It's not a regular unit, it's an unknown force!
column2: Sinyal yang diterima tidak bisa diidentifikasi... Itu bukan unit reguler, itu kekuatan tak dikenal!

column1: (As the third energy tower is forcibly blown up, the blinding white light on the railgun's barrel lets out a hoarse crackle of electricity, as if being choked, and rapidly weakens. The system can finally no longer provide it with an energy supply.)
column2: (Begitu menara energi ketiga dipaksa meledak, cahaya putih menyilaukan di laras railgun itu mengeluarkan derak listrik yang serak seperti tercekik, lalu melemah cepat. Sistemnya akhirnya tidak bisa lagi memasok energi untuknya.)

column1: (Taking advantage of the military forces being thrown into disarray by the bombing, several agile black figures charge into the battlefield at high speed under the cover of gunpowder smoke and blowing sand.)
column2: (Memanfaatkan pasukan militer yang jadi kacau karena pengeboman itu, beberapa figur hitam yang gesit menerjang masuk ke medan tempur dengan kecepatan tinggi di balik asap mesiu dan pasir yang bertiup.)

column1: (They completely ignore OTs-14 and the others who are locked in a bitter struggle, and instead, with extremely professional coordination, split into three groups and dive straight for the railgun's remaining outer energy arrays.)
column2: (Mereka sepenuhnya mengabaikan OTs-14 dan yang lain yang sedang bergulat berat, dan justru dengan koordinasi yang sangat profesional membelah diri jadi tiga kelompok lalu langsung menukik ke array energi luar railgun yang tersisa.)

column1: (Behind these figures followed a large number of extremely familiar mechanical creations. They flooded into the base like a tide, engaging in a slaughter with the military forces.)
column2: (Di belakang figur-figur itu menyusul sejumlah besar ciptaan mekanis yang sangat dikenal. Mereka membanjiri pangkalan seperti pasang, bertarung mati-matian dengan pasukan militer.)

column1: (All the mechanical creations had the same chilling logo painted on their shells.)
column2: (Semua ciptaan mekanis itu punya logo yang sama, yang membuat merinding, tercat di badannya.)

column1: Hey hey, can you hear me~ you Griffin trash?
column2: Hei hei, kedengaran tidak~ sampah Griffin?

column1: Haven't seen you in ten years, and you're still as useless as ever~
column2: Sepuluh tahun tidak bertemu, dan kalian tetap tidak berguna seperti dulu~

column1: Eh? But you just said they got a lot stronger—Ah, it hurts, hurts, hurts—!!
column2: Eh? Tapi tadi kau bilang mereka jadi jauh lebih kuat—Ah, sakit, sakit, sakit—!!

column1: ...It's been a while, Miss OTs-14.
column2: ...Sudah lama tidak bertemu, Miss OTs-14.

column1: And greetings to all the Dolls currently following the Master.
column2: Dan salam untuk semua Doll yang sekarang mengikuti Master.

column1: (OTs-14 looked at the figure ahead in shock.)
column2: (OTs-14 menatap figur di depannya dengan terkejut.)

column1: Sangvis Ferri? Assimilated forces...
column2: Sangvis Ferri? Pasukan yang berasimilasi...

column1: Leave the rest of the work to us.
column2: Serahkan sisa pekerjaannya pada kami.

column1: Compared to Griffin, we are undoubtedly the more appropriate candidates to deal with this orbital cannon.
column2: Dibanding Griffin, kami tidak diragukan lebih pantas menangani meriam orbital ini.

column1: Did you understand? If not, I'll translate it for you.
column2: Sudah paham? Kalau belum, akan kuterjemahkan untukmu.

column1: What Agent means is—you hindrances, get lost already.
column2: Maksud Agent adalah—kalian yang cuma menghalangi, minggir sana.

column1: Let the professionals handle it.
column2: Biar yang profesional menanganinya.

column1: What kind of professionals are you! Stop being so arrogant here!
column2: Profesional apanya kalian! Berhenti berlagak di sini!

column1: Are we wrong? When we were playing with Jupiter Cannons... you were still fighting Dinergates with fire pokers—
column2: Salah kami di mana? Waktu kami bermain dengan Jupiter Cannon... kalian masih memukuli Dinergates dengan besi pengorek tungku—

column1: Oh, wait, who are you?
column2: Oh, tunggu, kau siapa?

column1: You weren't even born back then, were you?
column2: Waktu itu kau bahkan belum lahir, kan?

column1: Hah—!? What's with these people, why do they talk just like Nemesis!?
column2: Hah—!? Ada apa dengan orang-orang ini, kenapa cara bicaranya persis Nemesis!?

column1: How did you know we were here...
column2: Bagaimana kalian tahu kami di sini...

column1: The Commander once told me that you've been in the Red Zone for years. Why have you appeared now?
column2: Commander pernah bilang kalian bertahun-tahun ada di Red Zone. Kenapa sekarang muncul?

column1: Of course it's that troublesome person!
column2: Tentu saja karena orang yang menyusahkan itu!

column1: Sent us over to do manual labor, while she herself said something like 'I still have things to do' and left first.
column2: Mengirim kami kemari jadi kuli, sementara dia sendiri bilang 'aku masih ada urusan' lalu pergi lebih dulu.

column1: Ah! She didn't secretly ditch us and run off to see the Commander first, did she?
column2: Ah! Jangan-jangan dia diam-diam meninggalkan kami dan kabur menemui Commander lebih dulu?

column1: We tracked The Elmo's signal all the way here.
column2: Kami melacak sinyal The Elmo sampai ke sini.

column1: We encountered an armored unit on the way, so we were delayed.
column2: Kami berhadapan dengan unit lapis baja di jalan, jadi tertunda.

column1: I really don't know if you guys are lucky enough, or if we're unlucky enough.
column2: Aku benar-benar tidak tahu apa kalian cukup beruntung, atau kami yang cukup sial.

column1: However, cheer up, your Messiah and Savior has arrived!
column2: Tapi, semangat, Messiah dan Savior kalian sudah datang!

column1: There's only Agent, Dreamer, you, and me here, right?
column2: Di sini cuma ada Agent, Dreamer, kau, dan aku, kan?

column1: Who are the Messiah and the Savior?
column2: Siapa yang Messiah dan Savior?

column1: Can you just keep quiet? You're dragging down the intelligence of the entire Sangvis Ferri.
column2: Bisa diam sedikit? Kau menurunkan tingkat kecerdasan seluruh Sangvis Ferri.

column1: You and Nemesis...
column2: Kau dan Nemesis...

column1: Ah? What are you doing?
column2: Ah? Kau sedang apa?

column1: You two will have to prepare a new comedy routine in the future, the newcomers' level has already surpassed your old tricks.
column2: Kalian berdua harus menyiapkan lawakan baru nanti, level anak-anak baru sudah melampaui trik lama kalian.

column1: (Helen narrowed her eyes. It seems this elite Sangvis Ferri unit conveniently took care of those military armored vehicles trying to flank The Elmo on their way here.)
column2: (Helen menyipitkan mata. Sepertinya unit elite Sangvis Ferri ini sekaligus membereskan kendaraan lapis baja militer yang mencoba mengapit The Elmo di perjalanan mereka ke sini.)

column1: ...Quiet. When speaking with those currently staying by the Master's side, you must not make such a fool of yourselves.
column2: ...Diam. Saat berbicara dengan mereka yang sekarang berada di sisi Master, kalian tidak boleh mempermalukan diri seperti itu.

column1: Right now, the Commander is in grave danger, and massive support is needed everywhere.
column2: Sekarang Commander dalam bahaya besar, dan dukungan besar dibutuhkan di mana-mana.

column1: Let's deal with things here as quickly as possible, then find a way to go back and help him.
column2: Mari beresi urusan di sini secepat mungkin, lalu cari cara untuk balik membantunya.

column1: After all, sharing the Master's burdens is a maid's duty.
column2: Lagi pula, meringankan beban Master adalah tugas seorang pelayan.

column1: At this moment, what we should show the Commander are the claws and fangs we have continuously sharpened over the past ten years, and prove that only Sangvis Ferri is the most suitable to be his sword and shield.
column2: Saat ini, yang harus kita tunjukkan kepada Commander adalah cakar dan gigi yang kita asah terus selama sepuluh tahun, dan membuktikan hanya Sangvis Ferri yang paling pantas menjadi pedang dan perisainya.

column1: ...It seems I should thank you on behalf of the Commander, but let's start the operation first.
column2: ...Sepertinya aku harus berterima kasih atas nama Commander, tapi mari mulai operasinya dulu.

column1: Hehe~ Now that you mention it, I kinda want to see the Commander's bitter face right now~
column2: Hehe~ Karena kau menyebutnya, aku jadi ingin melihat wajah pahit Commander sekarang~

column1: Alright everyone, let's finish this quickly.
column2: Baik semuanya, mari selesaikan ini cepat.

column1: (Outside the porthole is the deafening sound of artillery fire. But inside the porthole, beside Anjelie, it is terrifyingly quiet.)
column2: (Di luar jendela kapal itu terdengar dentuman artileri yang memekakkan. Tapi di dalamnya, di samping Anjelie, suasananya sunyi sampai menakutkan.)

column1: (She expressionlessly turns off all the alarms, leaving only one communication channel open for contact.)
column2: (Tanpa ekspresi dia mematikan semua alarm, menyisakan hanya satu saluran komunikasi yang terbuka.)

column1: (Now, a call comes through on this single communication channel.)
column2: (Sekarang, sebuah panggilan masuk di satu saluran komunikasi itu.)

column1: General... our energy transport vehicle has been destroyed, and the second main gun has been forced to shut down.
column2: General... kendaraan transpor energi kami hancur, dan meriam utama kedua dipaksa mati.

column1: According to your instructions, the various defense squads only executed containment tactics after engaging the enemy and did not launch a full-scale counterattack.
column2: Sesuai instruksi Anda, regu-regu pertahanan hanya menjalankan taktik penahanan setelah bersinggungan dengan musuh dan tidak melancarkan serangan balik besar-besaran.

column1: But the enemy suddenly received a large number of unknown reinforcements, and the outer energy array is gradually falling. Please instruct, should we completely abandon the launch?
column2: Tapi musuh tiba-tiba menerima bala bantuan tak dikenal dalam jumlah besar, dan array energi luar berangsur jatuh. Mohon perintah, apakah tembakannya dibatalkan sepenuhnya?

column1: Yes, cancel the launch. The objective has already been achieved.
column2: Ya, batalkan tembakannya. Tujuannya sudah tercapai.

column1: 'Great Red Spot' has completed its mission. The Ceres's initial combat objectives have been achieved. Let's begin the retreat.
column2: 'Great Red Spot' sudah menuntaskan tugasnya. Objektif tempur awal Ceres sudah tercapai. Mari mulai penarikan diri.

column1: Those Dolls' objective is to stop the launch; they won't pursue deeply.
column2: Objektif para Doll itu adalah menghentikan tembakannya; mereka tidak akan mengejar terlalu jauh.

column1: Yes. Also, this is the combat footage just synced back from the frontline squad.
column2: Baik. Selain itu, ini rekaman tempur yang baru disinkronkan dari regu garis depan.

column1: (Anjelie clicks on the sent footage. The screen plays the battle situation of The Elmo's assault squad charging the lines.)
column2: (Anjelie mengeklik rekaman yang dikirim itu. Layarnya memutar situasi pertempuran regu serbu The Elmo menerjang barisan.)

column1: (One of the tactical Dolls wearing a black hood is extremely active. Her combat combines berserk strength with an elegant rhythm, sometimes lifting a chariot to smash through the defense line, sometimes flanking at high speed, until the Leaf-Cutter Army deploys heavy mecha units to temporarily suppress her.)
column2: (Salah satu Doll taktis bertudung hitam sangat aktif. Pertarungannya menggabungkan kekuatan buas dengan irama yang elegan, sesekali mengangkat kereta perang untuk menghantam garis pertahanan, sesekali mengapit dengan kecepatan tinggi, sampai Leaf-Cutter Army mengerahkan unit mecha berat untuk menekannya sementara.)

column1: (However, what was truly noteworthy was this group of Dolls who came as reinforcements. Their tactical coordination and operational efficiency made Anjelie watch intently.)
column2: (Namun yang benar-benar patut dicatat adalah kelompok Doll yang datang sebagai bala bantuan. Koordinasi taktis dan efisiensi operasional mereka membuat Anjelie menonton dengan saksama.)

column1: This is truly an ideal tactical model. Commanders should really study it carefully.
column2: Ini benar-benar model taktis yang ideal. Para komandan seharusnya mempelajarinya dengan serius.

column1: General, what did you say?
column2: General, Anda bilang apa?

column1: ...Nothing, continue your report.
column2: ...Bukan apa-apa, lanjutkan laporanmu.

column1: The individual combat capabilities of the initial four tactical Dolls far exceeded our conventional assessments, especially the Doll in black leading them.
column2: Kemampuan tempur perorangan empat Doll taktis awal itu jauh melampaui penilaian konvensional kami, terutama Doll berpakaian hitam yang memimpin mereka.

column1: However... as long as we cut off their coordination, restricting them doesn't seem as difficult as imagined.
column2: Namun... selama koordinasi mereka diputus, mengekang mereka sepertinya tidak sesulit yang dibayangkan.

column1: But the Dolls that came as reinforcements are different. Their tactical coordination rhythm is perfect, and even the deployment of automated weapons looks like the work of a top-tier tactical master, posing a huge threat to us.
column2: Tapi Doll yang datang sebagai bala bantuan itu berbeda. Irama koordinasi taktis mereka sempurna, dan bahkan pengerahan senjata otomatisnya tampak seperti hasil kerja ahli taktik papan atas, jadi ancaman besar bagi kami.

column1: ...You joined the Leaf-Cutter Army three years ago, right?
column2: ...Kau masuk Leaf-Cutter Army tiga tahun lalu, kan?

column1: Yes! General.
column2: Benar! General.

column1: (Anjelie let out an imperceptible chuckle.)
column2: (Anjelie melepas kekehan yang nyaris tak terdengar.)

column1: Hehe, no wonder you're so unfamiliar with Griffin's tactical Dolls.
column2: Hehe, tidak heran kau begitu asing dengan Doll taktis Griffin.

column1: You haven't experienced the true terror of these tactical Dolls. They never fear death, and they have the determination to carry out tactics to the letter.
column2: Kau belum mengalami kengerian sesungguhnya dari Doll taktis itu. Mereka tidak pernah takut mati, dan punya tekad menjalankan taktik sampai ke huruf terakhir.

column1: It's just because their 'Commander' isn't present that they can't adapt to the situation.
column2: Hanya karena 'Commander' mereka tidak hadir, mereka tidak bisa menyesuaikan diri dengan situasinya.

column1: Yes, I understand.
column2: Baik, saya paham.

column1: It seems my experience is still too shallow...
column2: Sepertinya pengalaman saya masih terlalu dangkal...

column1: It's okay, this is just the beginning.
column2: Tidak masalah, ini baru permulaan.

column1: ...The beginning?
column2: ...Permulaan?

column1: Hehe. As time goes on, I'm afraid you'll witness even more things you haven't encountered before.
column2: Hehe. Seiring waktu, kurasa kau akan menyaksikan lebih banyak lagi hal yang belum pernah kau jumpai.

column1: Alright, get to work.
column2: Baik, kerjakan tugasmu.

column1: Send this recording to all squad leaders. Take these guys out within three hours.
column2: Kirim rekaman ini ke semua pemimpin regu. Habisi mereka dalam tiga jam.

column1: (After issuing all the orders, Anjelie cut off the final communication channel as well.)
column2: (Setelah mengeluarkan semua perintah, Anjelie memutus saluran komunikasi terakhirnya juga.)

column1: (She slowly turned around and walked down the command room's gangway in her military boots.)
column2: (Dia berbalik perlahan dan menuruni jembatan ruang komando dengan bot militernya.)

column1: (To the military, this was nothing more than an ordinary military strike mission planned for political maneuvering.)
column2: (Bagi militer, ini tidak lebih dari misi serangan biasa yang dirancang demi manuver politik.)

column1: (Under the guise of assisting Mangi Security in quelling the "internal rebellion in Mokosh," they would conveniently wipe out the "restless forces" led by the Commander.)
column2: (Dengan kedok membantu Mangi Security menumpas "pemberontakan internal di Mokosh", sekalian mereka melenyapkan "kekuatan yang tidak bisa diam" yang dipimpin Commander.)

column1: (Now, the situation in Mokosh had been completely muddied, and the military's strategic objective had been achieved. As for whether they could flatten The Elmo with one shot, it wasn't crucial to her.)
column2: (Sekarang situasi Mokosh sudah benar-benar keruh, dan objektif strategis militer sudah tercapai. Soal apakah The Elmo bisa diratakan dengan satu tembakan, itu tidak krusial bagi dia.)

column1: (Furthermore, even if that most important 'thing' is truly lost at this critical juncture, the blame won't fall on her head.)
column2: (Lebih dari itu, meski 'benda' terpenting itu benar-benar hilang di titik krusial ini, tudingannya tidak akan jatuh ke kepalanya.)

column1: (Anjelie walks to the window, gazing at the smoke-filled Yellow Zone battlefield in the distance.)
column2: (Anjelie melangkah ke jendela, menatap medan tempur Yellow Zone yang penuh asap di kejauhan.)

column1: (She is indeed very curious. In this dead-end situation surrounded by heavy sieges, what kind of trump card can the 'Commander', who has been watched by everyone, still pull out next.)
column2: (Dia memang sangat penasaran. Dalam situasi jalan buntu yang dikepung berlapis ini, kartu andalan macam apa lagi yang bisa dikeluarkan 'Commander' yang diawasi semua orang itu.)

column1: (But for now, her game of chess is finished.)
column2: (Tapi untuk sekarang, permainan caturnya sudah selesai.)

column1: (Anjelie chuckles softly.)
column2: (Anjelie terkekeh lirih.)

column1: Since the gears of fate have engaged...
column2: Karena roda gigi takdir sudah bertaut...

column1: Then let's leave the remaining sideshow to time.
column2: Maka sisa pertunjukan sampingannya kita serahkan pada waktu.
